description: Per-vault typed memory, its retention and sharing rules, the delegate run shape, and the boundary between the Go store and the Python authority gateway. Memory is an index over knowledge the node already owns; it is never a second vault, never authority, and never a shared corpus by itself.

implementation_state.go_store: implemented (gospark) — internal/memory and internal/delegates, cmd/sparknet-memory on loopback 4110; one JSON store per vault with an in-memory lexical index and an optional Qdrant semantic index (collection sparknet-memory; lexical fallback when embeddings/Qdrant are unavailable)
implementation_state.gateway: implemented (shared/sparknet-memory-gateway.py) — verifies signed grants and Open WebUI sessions, narrows to one vault, and forwards only to the Go service
implementation_state.node_surface: implemented in config for spark.compose.yml and goagx/sparknet.agx.compose.yml; live node start is DoD: confirm: user
implementation_state.master_content: read-through only; no permanent Master mirror. The read path is a signed admin request executed by the peer gateway and audited locally
implementation_state.not_built: Qdrant semantic ranking is a later additive backend; the first store is lexical and labels that honestly

values.episodic: what happened: turns, session summaries, daily notes, delegate handoffs
values.semantic: what is known: vault pages, entity facts, preferences, personas
values.procedural: how work is done: skills, agent prompts, tool/workflow traces
values.short_term: the current session's working set and cache; never cross-session and never shared
values.shared: workflow-scoped blackboard: commands, status, reports and artifacts for delegates

vault_scope.derivation: sha256(node_id + NUL + canonical absolute vault path); the path is stored only in the 0600 catalog
vault_scope.rule: one SQLite/JSON store per vault; no cross-vault query and no node-wide global memory
vault_scope.opencode: the session directory is the vault; opening the same peer-<id> vault in OpenCode returns the same vault_id
vault_scope.master: the Master role vault and its users' provisioned vaults follow the same rule

fields.source_kind: session | vault_page | tool_run | delegate | share | rfi | user_note | daily_note
fields.source_ref: vault-relative or opaque reference; absolute paths and '..' are refused
fields.source_digest: optional hash of the source bytes
fields.text: redacted record text, at most 64 KiB
fields.summary: optional compact summary, at most 8 KiB

consent.capture: the user allowed this record to be written
consent.share: the user allowed this record to be considered for a share
consent.uplift: the user allowed this record to be considered for consented uplift

fields.provenance: owner_id, owner_node, agent, model, share_ids[], ledger_ref
fields.content_hash: sha256 over type, source, scope, text and summary
fields.conflict_of: optional record id held for a human

rules: Secret-shaped values are redacted before a record is persisted.
A duplicate content hash returns the existing record; it does not create a near-duplicate.
A conflict is held and reported, never silently overwritten.
A suppressed record is hidden from retrieval; a deleted record keeps a tombstone and is not returned.
Retrieved records are marked used so a useful memory stays warm.

retention.zero_means: no expiry at the memory layer; the vault's own lifecycle still applies to semantic pages
retention.prune_rule: Prune suppresses expired records. It never deletes. Deletion is a user action and leaves a tombstone.
retention.master_mirror: none; Master content access is read-through and stores only request metadata and a digest

authority_boundary.go_service: holds no key, verifies no signature, writes no vault page and signs no note
authority_boundary.python_gateway: the only front door; verifies the signed grant or Open WebUI session and narrows to one vault
authority_boundary.master_access: a signed admin request with memory-supervise is executed by the peer gateway on demand; it is not an answer corpus and the Master AI must not ingest it
authority_boundary.no_capability: local memory reads and writes need no new capability; a signed grant's scope is the ceiling

knowledge_flow.local_memory: reads only the vault, the user's KB, accepted RFI/share pages, and local session evidence
knowledge_flow.cross_node: episodic and shared memory travel only inside an accepted session-handoff; semantic and procedural pages travel only as kb-view or kb-share
knowledge_flow.shared_memory: workflow-scoped and participant-scoped; it is not a fleet-wide corpus
knowledge_flow.master_metadata: counts, capture posture, retention and run status are telemetry/admin evidence, never knowledge

rules: The plan is validated before any task runs: unique ids, known dependencies, no cycles, known harness.
A delegate receives the caller's scope, never a wider scope; local memory is reached through the gateway.
A task failure never triggers a rerun of the original request; consumers are blocked.
A delegate writes to its workspace, never directly to the vault. A human approves a report before Python provenance signs it.
Budgets bound wall time and actionable steps; cancellation is cooperative and recorded.

share_bundle.shape: a bounded JSON bundle of records plus their source refs; it is a payload profile inside an existing session-handoff or kb-share, not a new share type
share_bundle.staging: the share regime stages it under 01_Inbox/share-<id>/; memory ingest happens only after acceptance
contents: project notes explicitly selected by the user

refusals.vault_forbidden: a path outside the configured vault roots
refusals.vault_not_found: an id not in the catalog
refusals.record_invalid: unknown type, empty content, unsafe source_ref, or an over-limit field
refusals.import_conflict: a differing record with the same content hash; held, not overwritten
refusals.grant_refused: signature, registry, expiry, capability or identity check failed
refusals.webui_unauthorized: the Open WebUI session did not resolve to a user
refusals.memory_unavailable: the Go store is down; the gateway fails closed for writes and open for chat
